title: Elements Of Management I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability an individual has to compel another to do something against his wish, despite any resistance."
Power is the ability an individual has to compel another to do something against his wish, despite any resistance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important functions of management- second perhaps, only to the function of decision-making."
Control is one of the most important functions of management- second perhaps, only to the function of decision-making.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the second step in creative thinking."
Investigation is the second step in creative thinking.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to give employees work instructions and other information needed to exercise the delegated authority."
Downward channels are used to give employees work instructions and other information needed to exercise the delegated authority.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the in-depth interview which is conducted to evaluate the applicant's acceptability in terms of his ability to fit into the company's culture and his "motives" in joining the company."

The sixth step is the in-depth interview which is conducted to evaluate the applicant's acceptability in terms of his ability to fit into the company's culture and his "motives" in joining the company.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process of searching for prospective employees and stimulating them to apply for jobs in an organisation."
Recruitment- recruitment refers to the process of searching for prospective employees and stimulating them to apply for jobs in an organisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means expansion of the operations of the company and addition of new areas of operations."
Growth means expansion of the operations of the company and addition of new areas of operations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a physical form of the thought which can be experienced and understood by one or more senses of the receiver."
The message- the message is a physical form of the thought which can be experienced and understood by one or more senses of the receiver.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a learned phenomenon from childhood and is influenced by family environment as well as external environment."
Cultural influences- culture is a learned phenomenon from childhood and is influenced by family environment as well as external environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important management tools."
Ratio Analysis- ratio analysis is one of the most important management tools.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as "the process of collecting and analysing information to determine the future supply of, and demand for, any given skill or job category"."
Manpower forecasting is defined as "the process of collecting and analysing information to determine the future supply of, and demand for, any given skill or job category".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an active mental process and goes beyond simply hearing."
Listening is an active mental process and goes beyond simply hearing.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the least expensive techniques of attracting white collar employees into junior level managerial and executive positions and other technical and career oriented jobs."
College recruitment is one of the least expensive techniques of attracting white collar employees into junior level managerial and executive positions and other technical and career oriented jobs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement and a predetermined guideline that provides direction for decision-making and action."
A policy is a statement and a predetermined guideline that provides direction for decision-making and action.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person who occupies a position of responsibility in coordinating the activities of the members of a group."
The leader is a person who occupies a position of responsibility in coordinating the activities of the members of a group.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those where prospective employees are available like employment exchanges."
Sources are those where prospective employees are available like employment exchanges.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method where groups of the successful applicants are brought around a conference table and are asked to discuss either a case study or a subject matter."
Group discussion is a method where groups of the successful applicants are brought around a conference table and are asked to discuss either a case study or a subject matter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used when the required expertise is not available in the organisation."
External specialists are used when the required expertise is not available in the organisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from the personnel policy of the organisation."
Recruitment policy of any organisation is derived from the personnel policy of the organisation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relatively new mathematical technique in situations requiring the optimum allocation of resources, money, capital equipment, raw material and personnel."
Linear programming is a relatively new mathematical technique in situations requiring the optimum allocation of resources, money, capital equipment, raw material and personnel.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a protection against bodily harm, danger, loss of employment, deprivation or threat."
Safety need is a protection against bodily harm, danger, loss of employment, deprivation or threat.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a systematic, organised and written statement of "who does what, when, where, how and why"."
Job specification is a systematic, organised and written statement of "who does what, when, where, how and why".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only way to ascertain how a message has been interpreted."
Feedback barriers- feedback is the only way to ascertain how a message has been interpreted.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the means by which management contacts prospective employees or stimulates them to apply for jobs; it is also the means of providing necessary information or exchanging idea."

Recruitment techniques are the means by which management contacts prospective employees or stimulates them to apply for jobs; it is also the means of providing necessary information or exchanging idea.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a social animal and shares relationship with his neighbours."
Man is a social animal and shares relationship with his neighbours.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known to have made some decisions in order to benefit themselves rather than to optimise public service."
Executives are known to have made some decisions in order to benefit themselves rather than to optimise public service.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of attracting qualified personnel, matching them with specific and suitable jobs, and assigning them to these jobs."
Recruitment is the process of attracting qualified personnel, matching them with specific and suitable jobs, and assigning them to these jobs.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the system of functions and devices adopted in a given company to ascertain whether the candidates' specifications are matched with the jobs specifications and requirements or not."

Selection procedure is the system of functions and devices adopted in a given company to ascertain whether the candidates' specifications are matched with the jobs specifications and requirements or not.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered to be one of the major problems of implementing any innovative plans."
Resistance to change is considered to be one of the major problems of implementing any innovative plans.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means answering for the use of your formal authority by someone else."
Accountability means answering for the use of your formal authority by someone else.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the organisational process that permits the transfer of authority from a superior to a subordinate."
Delegation is the organisational process that permits the transfer of authority from a superior to a subordinate.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the key to operational efficiency and should be set on the basis of past performance, degree of mechanisation, employee skills and training required, and motivation of employees."

Productivity- productivity goals are the key to operational efficiency and should be set on the basis of past performance, degree of mechanisation, employee skills and training required, and motivation of employees.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with securing the cooperation of workers for the realisation of organisational objectives."
Direction is concerned with securing the cooperation of workers for the realisation of organisational objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known for his work on time and motion studies."
Gilbreth is known for his work on time and motion studies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to anticipate the future, the time period allowed for achieving goals should be reasonable."
Even though planning is an attempt to anticipate the future, the time period allowed for achieving goals should be reasonable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most obvious sources and are primarily within the organisation itself, and include its present working force."
Internal sources are the most obvious sources and are primarily within the organisation itself, and include its present working force.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential ingredient of effective planning."
Objectivity is an essential ingredient of effective planning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with channeling human efforts towards the achievement of organisational goal."
Directing is concerned with channeling human efforts towards the achievement of organisational goal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a source of influence and a potential source of power."
Authority is a source of influence and a potential source of power.
